description: VN→ZH classifier over-generalization (条 family): Vietnamese learners default to 个, but long/thin things (鱼/裤子/裙子/河/船/路) take 条. Rule zh-ge-to-tiao rewrites 个 → 条 for a closed long/thin noun.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Rewrites 个 → 条 only before a closed long/thin noun (鱼/裤子/裙子/河/船/路) after a number/demonstrative. Compounds (鱼缸/鱼塘, 路口/路灯/路边) are guarded by tail lookaheads.

positive.notes: 一个裤子 → 一条裤子.

negative.notes: 人 genuinely takes 个 — not in the map, must abstain.
路口 (intersection) — 路 is not the counted head, the 口 tail lookahead guards it, must abstain.
